capabilities: Render frontmatter property values as coloured virtual graph nodes
Filter the graph by clicking a property node
Fold and unfold grouped notes with shift+click
Rename and toggle properties from the graph's Filters panel
Size property nodes by the number of grouped notes
extras: Depends on Obsidian's internal Graph View renderer APIs, which may change between Obsidian releases and could break the plugin.
intentEvidence: add them as virtual nodes in Obsidian's graph view
problem: Obsidian's graph view only groups notes by tags and links, so notes sharing a frontmatter property value have no visual grouping.

relations.evidence: originally inspired by the graph-injection approach used by Folders to Graph

summary: Graph view extension that renders frontmatter property values as virtual nodes so notes group visually by properties instead of tags or links.
